name: @soysouvanh/daox
description: Daox is a “Bare-Metal” and Database-First ORM for Node.js and TypeScript, designed from scratch to achieve absolute pure performance and strictly zero overhead.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --minify --clean -d dist && tsup src/cli/index.ts --format esm --minify --clean -d bin --external typescript --external postgres --external mysql2 --external better-sqlite3 --external mssql --external oracledb && mv bin/index.js bin/daox.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:db:up && NODE_OPTIONS="--experimental-vm-modules" jest tests/integration --runInBand --verbose && npm run test:db:down
